title.zh: 10月5日09:10 UTC再核：伤亡与口岸状态未变
title.en: 5 Oct 09:10 UTC recheck: casualties and port status unchanged
title.ne: 5 Oct 09:10 UTC: casualty ra port status same
title.hi: 5 Oct 09:10 UTC: casualty aur port status same

body.zh: 本轮再核新华社、指挥部通稿、gov.cn、@XHNews、@CCTV_Plus：中方仍为截至9月5日18时，43死、519失联、救出2人。epardafas 10月5日现文仍为周一5时遗体1457、失踪4718。获救仍用NDRRMA 9月26日13795。堰塞湖仍为新华社9月5日已排空。G216仍为交通厅9月28日双向管制。无新UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS激活。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: Recheck of Xinhua, command text, gov.cn, @XHNews and @CCTV_Plus: CN remains as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. epardafas 5 Oct text still says 1457 bodies and 4718 missing as of Monday 05:00. Rescued stays the NDRRMA 26 Sep figure 13795. Barrier lake remains Xinhua 5 Sep drained. G216 remains 28 Sep two-way control. No new UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS activation. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: Xinhua/command/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. epardafas 5 Oct: sombar 05:00 1457 sharir, 4718 harayeka. Uddar NDRRMA 26 Sep 13795. Tal Xinhua 5 Sep khali. G216 28 Sep niyantran. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua/command/gov.cn/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus: CN 5 Sep 18:00 43/519/2. epardafas 5 Oct: somvar 05:00 1457 sharir, 4718 lapata. Uddhar NDRRMA 26 Sep 13795. Jheel Xinhua 5 Sep khali. G216 28 Sep niyantran. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.en: epardafas 5 Oct: 1457 bodies, 4718 missing as of Monday 05:00

body.zh: epardafas：截至周一5时寻获1457具遗体，拉苏瓦236、Nuwakot 205、Dhading 73、Chitwan 369、Gorkha 80、Tanahun 38、Nawalparasi East 232、West 222，加德满都治疗中死亡2人。仍寻4718名失踪。安置点1226人。DNA：遗体1336、亲属2077。警力7975人。未更新获救数。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: epardafas: 1457 bodies as of Monday 05:00 — Rasuwa 236, Nuwakot 205, Dhading 73, Chitwan 369, Gorkha 80, Tanahun 38, Nawalparasi East 232, West 222, plus 2 deaths in Kathmandu treatment. Search continues for 4718 missing. 1226 in holding centres. DNA: 1336 deceased, 2077 relatives. 7975 police. Rescued not updated. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: epardafas: sombar 05:00 1457 sharir, 4718 harayeka, holding 1226. Rasuwa 236. DNA mritak 1336, natidar 2077. Police 7975. Uddar update chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: epardafas: somvar 05:00 1457 sharir, 4718 lapata, holding 1226. Rasuwa 236. DNA mritak 1336, rishte 2077. Police 7975. Uddhar update nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 10月5日：贝特拉瓦蒂法拉库河开始架贝雷桥
title.en: 5 Oct: Bailey bridge work started on Falakhu at Betravati
title.ne: 5 Oct: Betravati Falakhu ma Bailey bridge suru
title.hi: 5 Oct: Betravati Falakhu par Bailey bridge shuru

body.zh: Aarthik Abhiyan 10月5日：博特科西—特里舒里洪水后，贝特拉瓦蒂法拉库河开始架贝雷桥，连接努瓦科特与拉苏瓦。非官方伤亡源，不改KPI。地点不在锚点内，不标经纬度。
body.en: Aarthik Abhiyan 5 Oct: after the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli flood, Bailey bridge installation has started on the Falakhu at Betravati, linking Nuwakot and Rasuwa. Not an official casualty source; KPI unchanged. Place is not an anchor, so no lat/lng.
body.ne: Aarthik Abhiyan 5 Oct: Betravati Falakhu ma Bailey bridge suru, Nuwakot-Rasuwa jodcha. Casualty source hoina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: Aarthik Abhiyan 5 Oct: Betravati Falakhu par Bailey bridge shuru, Nuwakot-Rasuwa jodta hai. Casualty source nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 央视10月4日：中尼科考队从成都启程赴尼
title.en: CCTV 4 Oct: China-Nepal science team left Chengdu for Nepal
title.ne: CCTV 4 Oct: science team Chengdu bata Nepal tira
title.hi: CCTV 4 Oct: science team Chengdu se Nepal ke liye

body.zh: 央视10月4日：喜马拉雅8·26应急跨境科考队50余人从成都启程赴尼，溯源冰岩崩并服务吉隆口岸重建。无新伤亡，无现场坐标。
body.en: CCTV 4 Oct: 50-plus researchers of the Himalaya 26 Aug emergency team left Chengdu for Nepal to trace the ice-rock avalanche and support Gyirong Port reconstruction. No new casualties, no field coordinates.
body.ne: CCTV 4 Oct: 50+ scientist Chengdu bata Nepal tira. Naya casualty chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: CCTV 4 Oct: 50+ scientist Chengdu se Nepal ke liye. Naya casualty nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: NDRRMA 10月1日：搜救结束，转入失踪核查
title.en: NDRRMA 1 Oct: SAR ended, missing verification starts
title.ne: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj sakiyo, harayeka jaanch suru
title.hi: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj khatam, lapata satyapan shuru

body.zh: epardafas引NDRRMA执行主任Upreti：10月1日记者会称博特科西—特里舒里水道搜救阶段结束，转入恢复与失踪人员核查。未公布新伤亡数字。无新队伍坐标。
body.en: epardafas cites NDRRMA chief Upreti: 1 Oct press conference said Bhotekoshi-Trishuli SAR ended and recovery plus missing-person verification began. No new casualty figures. No new team coordinates.
body.ne: epardafas/NDRRMA Upreti: 1 Oct khoj sakiyo, recovery ra harayeka jaanch suru. Naya casualty chaina. GNSS chaina.
body.hi: epardafas/NDRRMA Upreti: 1 Oct khoj khatam, recovery aur lapata satyapan shuru. Naya casualty nahi. GNSS nahi.

title.zh: 交通厅9月28日：G216吉隆镇—国门仍双向管制
title.en: Transport dept 28 Sep: G216 town-gate still controlled
title.ne: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dui tira niyantran
title.hi: Transport 28 Sep: G216 dono disha niyantran

body.zh: 西藏自治区交通运输厅路网：G216 K3500+200（吉隆镇）—K3525+850（吉隆国门）自8月26日起双向交通管制，解除时间待定。本轮无更新。
body.en: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200 (Gyirong town) to K3525+850 (gate) remains two-way controlled since 26 Aug; lift time unset. No update this cycle.
body.ne: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug dekhi dui tira niyantran. Yo cycle update chaina.
body.hi: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200-K3525+850 26 Aug se dono disha niyantran. Is cycle update nahi.

body.zh: PTI引NDRRMA 9月26日：1453死、5285失踪、13795获救。死亡与失踪已被更新口径替代；KPI获救仍用此数，因本轮无更新。
body.en: PTI cites NDRRMA 26 Sep: 1453 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued. Dead and missing superseded; KPI rescued stays at 13795 because this cycle has no newer rescued figure.
body.ne: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: uddar 13795. Mrit/harayeka naya le badleko. Uddar naya chaina.
body.hi: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: uddhar 13795. Mrit/lapata naya se badle. Uddhar naya nahi.

title.zh: 指挥部9月6日：截至9月5日18时 43死519失联
title.en: Command 6 Sep: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing
title.ne: Command 6 Sep: 5 Sep 18:00, 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin

body.zh: 人民日报/中国西藏网引吉隆应急救援指挥部：截至9月5日18时，43人遇难、519人失联、成功救出2人、遗物993件。外籍失联261人、23国。此后新华社与@XHNews未见更新伤亡。
body.en: People's Daily and tibet.cn cite the Gyirong command: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued, 993 personal effects. 261 missing foreigners from 23 countries. No later casualty update from Xinhua or @XHNews.
body.ne: Command: 5 Sep 18:00 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin, 2 uddar. Bideshi 261. Xinhua pachi naya casualty chaina.
body.hi: Command: 5 Sep 18:00 43 mrit, 519 lapata, 2 uddhar. Videshi 261. Xinhua ke baad naya casualty nahi.

title.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空
title.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained
title.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: port mathi ko bandha tal khali
title.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: port ke upar ka barrier lake khali

body.zh: 新华社引应急管理部门：口岸核心区上方堰塞湖已排空，河道恢复过流，险情基本解除。本轮无新堰塞湖通报。
body.en: Xinhua cites emergency management: lake above the port core has drained, the channel is flowing, and the hazard is largely eliminated. No later barrier-lake bulletin.
body.ne: Xinhua: tal khali, nadi sadharan, jokhim hatyo. Pachi naya tal bulletin chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua: jheel khali, nadi normal, khatra hat gaya. Baad mein naya jheel bulletin nahi.

title.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: do not travel Rasuwagadhi-Timure
title.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: Rasuwagadhi-Timure mat jao

body.zh: 使馆道路告示仍为9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi。本轮未见更新告示。
body.en: Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep: do not travel to Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi. No newer notice found.
body.ne: Embassy notice 3 Sep nai: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi najau. Naya notice chaina.
body.hi: Embassy notice 3 Sep hi: Rasuwagadhi-Timure-Syafrubesi mat jao. Naya notice nahi.

detail.zh: 口岸设施已毁，通关未恢复。中方关闭。
detail.en: Port facilities destroyed; clearance not restored. Chinese side closed.
detail.ne: Port dhvasta; clearance khuleko chaina. Chiniya taraf band.
detail.hi: Port dhvast; clearance nahi. Chini taraf band.

detail.zh: 交通厅9月28日路网：K3500+200—K3525+850双向管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道仅救援。
detail.en: Transport bulletin 28 Sep: K3500+200-K3525+850 two-way control, lift time unset. Rescue track only.
detail.ne: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato matra.
detail.hi: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200-K3525+850 dono disha niyantran. Rescue path hi.

name.zh: 贝特拉瓦蒂法拉库河贝雷桥

detail.zh: Aarthik Abhiyan 10月5日：开始架贝雷桥，连接努瓦科特与拉苏瓦。非锚点，不标经纬度。
detail.en: Aarthik Abhiyan 5 Oct: Bailey bridge installation started, linking Nuwakot and Rasuwa. Not an anchor; no lat/lng.
detail.ne: 5 Oct Bailey bridge suru. Anchor hoina; GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Oct Bailey bridge shuru. Anchor nahi; GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 截至9月5日18时：2500余人，核心区搜寻与消杀已覆盖。无新现场坐标。
detail.en: As of 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ personnel; core search and disinfection covered. No new live GNSS.
detail.ne: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ jana; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ log; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: NDRRMA 10月1日：搜救阶段结束，转入失踪核查。epardafas 10月5日仍部7975名警员处置遗体并寻找失踪者。无新队伍坐标，故不标经纬度。
detail.en: NDRRMA 1 Oct: SAR phase ended; missing-person verification underway. epardafas 5 Oct still lists 7975 police on remains and missing search. No new team GNSS, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj sakiyo. epardafas 5 Oct: police 7975. Toli GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: NDRRMA 1 Oct: khoj khatam. epardafas 5 Oct: police 7975. Team GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 9月5日指挥部：核心区搜寻与预防性消杀已全覆盖。
detail.en: 5 Sep command: core-area search and preventive disinfection fully covered.
detail.ne: 5 Sep command: core khoj ra disinfection cover.
detail.hi: 5 Sep command: core khoj aur disinfection cover.

detail.zh: 8月30日发布会：转移安置吉隆镇、萨勒乡5村499人。9月8日新华社称444人已返回。本轮无更新。
detail.en: 30 Aug briefing: 499 relocated from Gyirong town and Sale. Xinhua 8 Sep: 444 returned after lake risk eased. No update this cycle.
detail.ne: 30 Aug: 499 sthanantran. Xinhua 8 Sep: 444 firta. Yo cycle update chaina.
detail.hi: 30 Aug: 499 sthanantran. Xinhua 8 Sep: 444 wapas. Is cycle update nahi.

detail.zh: epardafas 10月5日：各区安置点现1226人。地点不明，不标经纬度。
detail.en: epardafas 5 Oct: 1226 people in holding centres across districts. Place unclear, no lat/lng.
detail.ne: epardafas 5 Oct: holding ma 1226. Thau spashta chaina.
detail.hi: epardafas 5 Oct: holding mein 1226. Sthan spasht nahi.

status.zh: 堰塞湖已排空，河道正常过流（新华社9月5日，本轮无更新）
status.en: Barrier lake drained; channel flowing normally (Xinhua 5 Sep, no update this cycle)
status.ne: Bandha tal khali; nadi sadharan (Xinhua 5 Sep, yo cycle update chaina)
status.hi: Barrier lake khali; nadi normal (Xinhua 5 Sep, is cycle update nahi)

text.zh: @XHNews 10月5日09:01 UTC最新帖为西班牙提前选举，非吉隆灾情。未见新伤亡。
text.en: @XHNews latest post at 5 Oct 09:01 UTC is on a Spanish election, not Gyirong. No new casualties.
text.ne: @XHNews 5 Oct 09:01 UTC Spain chunab, Gyirong hoina. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: @XHNews 5 Oct 09:01 UTC Spain chunav, Gyirong nahi. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: @CCTV_Plus 10月5日09:00 UTC最新帖为冲绳抗议，非吉隆。未见新伤亡。
text.en: @CCTV_Plus latest post at 5 Oct 09:00 UTC is an Okinawa protest, not Gyirong. No new casualties.
text.ne: @CCTV_Plus 5 Oct 09:00 UTC Okinawa, Gyirong hoina. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: @CCTV_Plus 5 Oct 09:00 UTC Okinawa, Gyirong nahi. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: @XHNews 9月10日：国家气候中心向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测与预报，支持吉隆—拉苏瓦口岸泥石流救援。无新伤亡。
text.en: @XHNews 10 Sep: National Climate Center is providing Nepal rolling climate monitoring and forecasts for Gyirong-Rasuwa mudslide relief. No new casualties.
text.ne: @XHNews 10 Sep: climate forecast Gyirong-Rasuwa uddar. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: @XHNews 10 Sep: climate forecast Gyirong-Rasuwa relief. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: @CCTV_Plus 9月10日：灾后留在吉隆镇的尼泊尔务工人员恢复工作。无新伤亡数字。
text.en: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Nepali workers who stayed in disaster-hit Gyirong town are returning to work. No new casualty figures.
text.ne: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Gyirong town ma Nepali karmiharu kaam ma pharke. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: @CCTV_Plus 10 Sep: Gyirong town mein Nepali karmchari kaam par laut rahe hain. Naya casualty nahi.
